 Census self-enumeration process awareness session in Canacona
 Bid to guide locals to participate using mobile phones
 The Goan Network Published Nov 19, 2026, 11:20 PM IST 
 SHARE ON 
 PRINT 
 Field Trainer Vihar V. N. Desai explaining the self-enumeration process for Census 2027 through mobile phones at the Canacona Municipal Council Hall. 
 CANACONA 
 The Canacona Municipal Council (CMC) organised an awareness session at the municipal hall to familiarise citizens with the census self-enumeration process and to encourage their active participation. 
 The initiative aimed to guide citizens on how to complete the self-enumeration process independently using their mobile phones. 
 During the session, Field Trainer Vihar V. N. Desai provided detailed information about the importance, procedure and benefits of self-enumeration. 
 He explained that the Census is an important exercise for collecting official data on the country's population and its social and economic conditions. He emphasised that every citizen's participation is essential and that accurate information must be provided during the process. 
 Through the self-enumeration facility, citizens will be able to enter the required details themselves using their mobile phones. This will enable them to participate directly in the census process alongside the conventional method of data collection. The trainer stressed the importance of understanding the procedure and correctly filling in the required details to complete the process successfully. 
 Following the awareness session, participants were given hands-on training on how to initiate the self-enumeration process on their mobile phones, enter the necessary information and complete the registration procedure. They were also given an opportunity to carry out the process on their own mobile devices. The trainer guided them through each step, providing practical experience and helping them understand how to complete the process independently. 
 Members of various self-help groups, officials and staff of the Canacona Municipal Council, along with local residents, attended the programme. 
 The main objective of the initiative was to create awareness about the self-enumeration process, encourage the use of technology for submitting information and ensure maximum public participation in Census 2027. 
 Citizens were urged to familiarise themselves with the self-enumeration process, submit their details accurately as per the prescribed procedure and extend their cooperation for the successful implementation of Census 2027.
